 Silo Workspace 
MPGSOC, a managed security services provider, promises its customers the expertise, tools and experience required to implement a system that fits their unique needs quickly and effectively. A critical tool to that promise is Silo.
We sat down with Tom Bakry, manager at MPGSOC, to learn how he leverages Silo to improve his service to customers — and to make his job easier. Watch the video to learn why he turns to Silo every day to investigate security issues raised by customers, protect his own organization and deliver the best intel possible.
Better together: Silo and MPGSOC
Silo gives us the ability to impose a layer of abstraction between us and bad actors. It gives us a chance to safely evaluate things that come our way, and it makes us more efficient and safer in doing that.
Tom Bakry, MPGSOC manager
